bearingSource: OSM way 1360982485 (the whole hall + office complex, 29.8 × 145 m): front edge 73.45°, long sides 163.3° — checked 13 Nov 2026 against the OSM API, no change needed. The drone photos (DJI_0550–0557) confirm that the office block with the green mesh stands across the south end of the hall, its street front facing 163.4° (SSE, +Z), with the second building and the car park to the west (−X) and the field fence to the east. Model origin = the project's geo point (plus code 8894+QR), 10.6 m east of the hall's west wall and 2.3 m in front of the OSM front edge; the composition is placed on the OSM outline, not re-centred.
approximations: Plan from the OSM outline (29.8 × 145 m) and a homography of the near-vertical drone photo DJI_0556 fitted to its roof corners: office depth 17–22 m → 20 m; second building ≈ 14.7 × 38.2 m, 13.6 m behind the office front and 17.6 m west of the hall; PV field ≈ 12 × 48 m on the north third; site outlines ± 1–2 m. Heights scaled from the frontal ground photos with the 29.8 m front: green mesh to ≈ 8.5 m with a ≈ 0.9 m silver screen above, the lettering corner (projecting 1.8 m) ≈ 0.5 m taller as it reads in the ground photos (perspective and real height cannot be fully separated), hall ≈ 8.4 m, second building ≈ 7.6 m (mesh 7.7 m, screen to ≈ 8.6 m). Mesh grid ≈ 1.45 × 0.95 m (second building ≈ 1.6 × 1.25 m); window positions behind the mesh, the hall's north end and doors, the number of racks and the canopy steps are estimates. The 'COLOR METAL' lettering is drawn in a system sans-serif, without the '20' anniversary numerals that the 2025 photos still show. Site kept light: paving, planted beds and island, eight ball trees, the pergola and the yard barrier; cars, fences, signs, the transformer kiosk and the neighbouring premises are omitted. A third dark-grey hall behind the second building (ownership not documented) is not modelled.

note.ro: Machetă a întregului sediu, realizată după fotografiile COLOR METAL (vederi cu drona și de la sol) pe conturul OpenStreetMap: blocul de birouri îmbrăcat în plasă expandată de aluminiu verde, cu colțuri rotunjite, paravan de acoperiș argintiu, loggie cu placaj bronz și inscripția COLOR METAL, hala de depozitare de 145 m cu copertinele rampelor și panourile fotovoltaice, a doua clădire cu capătul spre stradă în aceeași plasă verde, precum și curtea cu spațiile verzi. Înălțimile și pozițiile sunt măsurate din fotografii, iar ferestrele din spatele plasei și detaliile curții sunt aproximate.
note.hu: A teljes székház makettje a COLOR METAL drón- és földi felvételei alapján, az OpenStreetMap-körvonalra illesztve: a zöld expandált alumíniumhálóval burkolt, lekerekített sarkú irodaépület ezüst tetőparavánnal, bronzburkolatú loggiával és COLOR METAL felirattal, a 145 m-es raktárcsarnok a rámpák előtetőivel és a napelemekkel, az utca felőli végén ugyanilyen zöld hálóval burkolt második épület, valamint az udvar a zöldfelületekkel. A magasságok és helyzetek a fotókból mértek, a háló mögötti ablakok és az udvar részletei közelítők.
note.en: Model of the whole headquarters, built from COLOR METAL's drone and ground photographs on the OpenStreetMap outline: the office block wrapped in green expanded aluminium mesh with rounded corners, a silver roof screen, the bronze-clad loggia and the COLOR METAL lettering; the 145 m warehouse hall with its loading-dock canopies and solar panels; the second building, whose street end is wrapped in the same green mesh; and the yard with its planted areas. Heights and positions are measured from the photos; windows behind the mesh and yard details are approximate.
